content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
UID
Unix User Identifier.
GID
Unix Group Identifier.
UnixMode
Describes the traditional Unix permissions of a file system entry (eg. 0755).
PatternId
The ID of the pattern
